sections.name: Child Development & Pedagogy (बाल विकास एवं शिक्षण विधियां)
Science & Mathematics OR Social Studies (विज्ञान-गणित अथवा सामाजिक अध्ययन)

subjects.name: Child Development, Pedagogy & Teaching-Learning Process (बाल विकास, शिक्षण विधियाँ, RTE 2009 एवं क्रियात्मक अनुसंधान)
domains: Child Development: Principles of Growth & Development, Genetic & Environmental Determinants, Stages of Development
Theories of Learning: Piaget, Vygotsky, Kohlberg, Bruner, Thorndike, Skinner, Pavlov, Gestalt Insight Theory
Individual Differences & Personality: Types, Traits, Factors Affecting, Assessment of Personality (Projective & Objective tests)
Intelligence Theories & Measurement: Gardner Multiple Intelligences, Spearman Two-Factor, Sternberg Triarchic Theory, IQ & EQ
Inclusive Education: Children with Special Needs (CWSN), Learning Disabilities (Dyslexia, Dyscalculia, Dysgraphia, ADHD, Autism)
Teaching-Learning Process: Constructivism, Bloom's Taxonomy, Teaching Methods, Motivation & Learning Theories (Maslow)
Assessment & Evaluation: Formative vs Summative Assessment, CCE (Continuous & Comprehensive Evaluation), Diagnostic & Remedial Teaching
Statutory Frameworks: Right to Education Act 2009 (RTE 2009), National Education Policy 2020 (NEP 2020), NCF 2005 & NCF-FS/SE
Action Research (क्रियात्मक अनुसंधान): Meaning, Steps, Implementation in Classroom Settings

subjects.name: Mathematics, Science & Environmental Studies (गणित, सामान्य विज्ञान एवं पर्यावरण अध्ययन)
domains: Number System & Arithmetic: Place Value, Fractions, Decimals, LCM & HCF, Unitary Method, Percentage, Simple Interest, Profit & Loss
Algebra & Geometry: Linear Equations, Exponents, Angles, Triangles, Quadrilaterals, Circles, Perimeter, Area, Surface Area & Volume
Physics: Motion, Force, Newton's Laws, Work, Energy, Heat & Temperature, Light (Reflection, Refraction, Lenses, Mirrors), Sound, Electricity
Chemistry: Matter & States, Physical & Chemical Changes, Elements, Compounds, Mixtures, Atoms & Molecules, Acids, Bases & Salts, Metals & Non-metals
Biology & Human Physiology: Cell Structure, Plant & Animal Tissues, Human Organ Systems (Digestive, Circulatory, Respiratory, Nervous), Microorganisms, Nutrition & Diseases
EVS - Family, Society & Living Habits: Family Structure, Social Evils (Child Marriage, Dowry, Child Labour), Clothes & Habitats, Public Places & Institutions
EVS - Nature, Ecology & Conservation: Ecosystems, Food Chain & Web, Biodiversity of Rajasthan, National Parks & Sanctuaries, Water Conservation (Baoris, Johad, Tanka), Solar Energy
Pedagogy of Mathematics, Science & Environmental Studies: Nature of Mathematics, Inductive-Deductive Method, Laboratory Method, EVS Integrated Approach

subjects.name: Languages - Hindi, English & Sanskrit Grammar with Pedagogy (भाषा ज्ञान - हिन्दी, अंग्रेजी एवं संस्कृत व्याकरण तथा शिक्षण विधियां)
domains: Hindi Grammar: Sandhi, Samas, Upsarg, Pratyay, Vilom, Paryayvachi, Tatsam-Tadbhav, Shuddh-Ashuddh, Muhavare va Lokoktiyan, Karak, Kaal, Vachya
Hindi Pedagogy: Bhasha Shikshan ki Vidhiyan, Bhashayi Kaushal (Shravan, Vachan, Pathan, Lekhan), Shikshan Sahayak Samagri, Upcharatmak Shikshan
English Grammar: Parts of Speech, Tenses, Subject-Verb Agreement, Active & Passive Voice, Direct & Indirect Speech, Articles & Prepositions, Vocabulary (Synonyms, Antonyms, Idioms)
English Pedagogy: Principles of Language Teaching, Communicative Language Teaching (CLT), Remedial Teaching, Teaching of Poetry & Prose
Sanskrit Grammar: Sandhi, Samas, Vibhakti, Dhatu Roop, Shabd Roop, Karaka, Pratyaya (Krit, Taddhita), Upasarga, Chhanda & Alankara Basics
Sanskrit Pedagogy: Sanskrit Shikshan Vidhaya (Pathshala Vidhi, Bhandarkar Vidhi, Pathyakram Vidhi), Bhasha Kaushal Shikshan

subjects.name: Rajasthan History, Art, Culture, Geography, Economy & Educational Scenario (राजस्थान का भूगोल, इतिहास, कला-संस्कृति एवं शैक्षिक परिदृश्य)
domains: Rajasthan Physical Geography: Physiographic Divisions (Thar Desert, Aravalli Range, Eastern Plains, Hadoti Plateau), Drainage Systems (Chambal, Banas, Luni, Mahi), Climate & Soil Types
Rajasthan Minerals, Agriculture & Economy: Major Crops, Mineral Wealth (Zinc, Lead, Marble, Gypsum, Rock Phosphate), Livestock & Dairy, Solar & Renewable Energy

Rajasthan History: Ancient Civilizations (Kalibangan, Ahar, Ganeshwar, Bairat), Major Dynasties (Guhil/Sisodiya, Rathore, Kachhwaha, Chauhan), 1857 Revolt in Rajasthan, Prajamandal Movements & Rajasthan Integration (7 Stages)

Art, Architecture & Culture: UNESCO Hill Forts of Rajasthan (Chittorgarh, Kumbhalgarh, Ranthambore, Amber, Jaisalmer, Gagron), Havelis, Stepwells (Baori), Temples, Miniature Paintings (Mewar, Marwar, Kishangarh Bani Thani, Bundi)

Folk Traditions, Fairs & Festivals: Folk Deities (Panchpir: Ramdevji, Pabuji, Gogaji, Mehaji, Harbhuji; Tejaji, Devnarayanji), Folk Dances (Ghoomar, Kalbelia, Chari, Gair, Bhavai), Fairs (Pushkar, Kolayat, Beneshwar Dham, Ramdevra)

Social Studies & Indian Polity: Harappan Civilization, Vedic Period, Mauryas & Guptas, Bhakti & Sufi Movements, Indian Constitution (Preamble, Fundamental Rights, Directive Principles, Parliament, Judiciary)
Rajasthan Educational Scenario: DIET, SCERT Rajasthan, SIERT Udaipur, Shala Darpan, Shala Samvad, SMILE Program, DIKSHA RISE, Mahatma Gandhi English Medium Schools, RTE in Rajasthan
